-Ground truth by exit code (D81). The probe runs `python3 scripts/animation/probe-inbetweens.py --all v3/poses --frames-root out --joints-root out` in the renderer root: for every pose sheet it reads `out/<shot>-figure-seq/` (the figure-only composition rendered as a png sequence, `--props='{"captions":false}'`) and `out/<shot>-joints.json` (`npm run joints -- <shot>`), skips a shot with neither and fails when none ran. Its first lines are its controls. On FAIL quote the line naming the joint and frames (a straight path, even spacing, a snapped secondary, a frozen hold) and fix the pose sheet or the breakdown poses, never the probe. Control: a linear lerp between two keys is refused.
+Ground truth by exit code (D81). The probe runs `python3 scripts/animation/probe-all.py --shots v3/poses --frames-root out --joints-root out` in the renderer root: for every pose sheet it reads `out/<shot>-figure-seq/`, `out/<shot>-joints.json` (`npm run joints -- <shot>`) and `out/<shot>-xsheet.json`, prints one line per probe per shot (twos, holds, inbetweens), skips a shot with no frames and fails when none ran. Controls print first. On FAIL quote the line naming the joint, move or frames (a straight path, an undeclared reversal, even spacing, a snapped secondary, a frozen hold, a move outside 3–6 drawings) and fix the pose sheet's declared shape or the mechanics, never the probe. Control: a linear lerp and a zigzag are each refused.
